change: Increase BGP keepalive and hold timers on all three virtual hubs
Remove the hub-west preference that prefers incident prefixes via hub-central
Add an export policy on hub-central to block provider-learned prefixes from being advertised to peer hubs
Add an export policy on hub-east to block peer-learned prefixes from being advertised back to Virtual WAN transit
Apply valley-free export policies on hub-central and hub-east so provider-learned routes stay off peers and peer-learned routes stay off the provider
Enable Virtual WAN routing intent so inter-hub traffic must use the Virtual WAN transit path
Install UDR overrides for both affected prefixes so hub-west and hub-east forward through Virtual WAN next hops
Disable hub peering between hub-central and hub-east
Set an explicit preference hierarchy on all hubs: local spokes first, Virtual WAN transit second, peer hubs last
Restart the VPN and ExpressRoute gateway processes on each hub
